title: 40% off Garmin Smartwatches (Limited to The First 1,000 Members) @ AIA Vitality
body:
Deal: 40% off Garmin Smartwatches (Limited to The First 1,000 Members) @ AIA Vitality

[WatchGeek] Does it have the new Cirqa or only the smartwatches?
[satcher] Only received 30% but code works on Cirqa.
[WatchGeek] Is it through the AIA app or directly from Garmin website?
Don't have AIA, looking to request the code through classifieds if it's through Garmin.
Thanks
[satcher] You can use the discount code directly on the Garmin website. No need to click through the app.
[sachz] Bupa has 25% and not limited to 1000 people….
[Iwantthatbargain] if you achieve 4 out of 6 weekly physical activity targets
What does that mean?
[odysseus] It's part of the Vitality program. If you aren't a Vitality user it doesn't apply.
[JimNZ] Managed to grab a new watch I've been eyeing for months, thanks OP (and code donor)!
